title: egenolfia hamiltoniana
intro: Egenolfia hamiltoniana, commonly known as Kali Musli or Swertia angustifolia, is a type of plant that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its numerous health benefits such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Egenolfia hamiltoniana include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
